items.title: LM Studio Agent Remote Control: run agents on any device over end-to-end encrypted LM Link
items.summary: LM Studio adds Agent Remote Control so agents running on a home machine can be reached and driven from other devices, encrypted end to end over LM Link. Bionic shipped support the same day, aimed at people with a Mac mini or Mac Studio at home.

items.title: Thinking Machines Inkling 2 Small on ARC-AGI (verified): 96.5% ARC-AGI-1, 81.7% ARC-AGI-2, 2.6% ARC-AGI-3
items.summary: ARC Prize verified Inkling 2 Small scores: it beat DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on ARC-AGI-1 (96.5% vs 94.5%) and ARC-AGI-2 (81.7% vs 78.1%) but trailed on ARC-AGI-3 (2.6% vs 5.8%), at $704 total in the provider-adapter setup. Reproduction code and testing policy are linked.

items.title: Scarlet AI video editor update: long video to editable shorts, motion graphics, Premiere/Final Cut/Resolve handoff, Ubuntu 24.04 preview
items.summary: Scarlet's open repo adds turning long videos into editable shorts, motion graphics and transitions, cleaner dialogue cuts, frame-by-frame scrubbing and background exports, with handoff to Premiere, Final Cut or Resolve and an Ubuntu 24.04 preview.

items.title: NeurIPS paper: a small set of LLM neurons track step-level reward, with 'dopamine' neurons that encode TD errors usable as process reward
items.summary: The authors report that reward signals in LLM hidden states sit in a small set of value neurons and dopamine neurons, the latter encoding step-level temporal-difference errors that can serve as a built-in process reward to improve reasoning. No code or numbers were visible in the posts read.
items.vendor: Stanford (authors Guowei Xu, Mert Yuksekgonul, James Zou)
